tiersDoc: Hardware sizing only: how much model this machine can hold. Selected first-match by ascending memoryGiBMax, so the open-ended tier stays last. Task difficulty lives in taskTiers; mixing the two makes an unconditional null match shadow every size.
taskTiersDoc: Task difficulty only: how much brain a request deserves. Never keyed by memory. Declarative today — no automatic router consumes this yet, and reaching tier 3 stays an explicit operator act per hostedTransmission.

taskTiers.name: tier-0-no-llm
taskTiers.description: Tool routing: grep, search, filesystem metadata, git status, calculations. Never sends a prompt payload to any model.

taskTiers.name: subconscious-35b-a3b
taskTiers.description: The default worker for 80-90% of agent work.

taskTiers.name: deliberate-27b-dense
taskTiers.description: Difficult reasoning, when tier 1 fails or reports low confidence. Active on the MLX backend: served by Ollama (127.0.0.1:11434) and by the hii-native MLX-VLM engine (127.0.0.1:11435) as mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-4bit.

taskTiers.name: hosted
taskTiers.description: Operator-invoked only, through /codex or /claude. Never entered automatically.

tiers.0: Deterministic — no LLM, tool routing only
tiers.1: qwen3.8:27b-mlx (default worker on the MLX backend — 80–90% of agent work)
tiers.2: qwen3.8:27b-mlx, extended (deliberate reasoning brain — difficult reasoning when tier-1 fails or reports low confidence)
tiers.3: cloud only — when local models fail, task is extremely consequential, or explicitly requested

mlxBACKEND.engine: MLX via Ollama on 127.0.0.1:11434; also hii-native MLX-VLM on 127.0.0.1:11435 (mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-4bit)

metadata.reason: Configure qwen3.8:27b-mlx on the MLX backend as active local worker + 27B deliberate reasoning model.
